leadText: Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction (Japanese: の とディアンシー The Cocoon of Destruction and Diancie) is the adaptation of the movie of the same name. It is adapted by 北村謙次 Kenji Kitamura.
plainText:
Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction (Japanese: の とディアンシー The Cocoon of Destruction and Diancie) is the adaptation of the movie of the same name. It is adapted by 北村謙次 Kenji Kitamura.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Differences between the movie and the manga==
Argus and Millis's surname is never mentioned in the manga.
In the manga, there is a flashback scene where fleeing Pokémon are turned into stone and restored to life by 's . This scene does not exist in the movie.
The battle between and Astrid is notably shortened in the manga, only having Ash's Hawlucha face Astrid's .
The bus and shooting star scenes are notably shortened in the manga, only noted in a few panels on one page.
In the manga, the shopping mall scene is notably shorter than in the movie, cutting out the parts where , , and go shopping, as well as leaving out 's Clemontic Gear. Instead, the manga only features the Carbink appearing and Ash using Hawlucha to save Diancie.
In the manga, shortly before 's awakening, tries to attack Millis's , but gets blocked by . This brief scene doesn't occur in the movie.
In the movie, when Yveltal is about to attack Argus and Millis, Millis's Chesnaught blocks Yveltal's with , and the shockwave forces them to land. In the manga, Argus and Millis instead have their and attack Yveltal with , but the attacks don't work, and Yveltal shoots them down with Hyper Beam.
In the manga, when Yveltal is attacking the group, multiple rise from the ground and form a wall to protect Diancie. In the movie, Merrick, Bort, Allotrope, and Dace are the only Carbink seen in this scene.
